name: Hannah
text: Amara talked me out of going too light and she was right. It grew out so softly that I waited four months before my next visit.

name: Daniel
text: Jonah asked how I style it on a normal morning before he picked up the scissors. Five minutes with the dryer and it looks the same.

name: Sophie
text: Mei showed me which products to avoid for the first few days. My hair is easier to dry and still has body.

name: Liam
text: My six year old sat still for the whole cut. The chair was lowered for him and nobody hurried us.

name: Grace
text: I booked a brow shape on my phone while on the tram and was in a chair that afternoon. The massage afterwards was a lovely surprise.
